name: Tite (Adenor Leonardo Bacchi)
scopeNote: Counted: Corinthians 2010-2013 (Brasileirao 2011, Libertadores and Club World Cup 2012; sources describe a compact, defensive side that scored little), Corinthians 2015-Jun 2016 (Brasileirao 2015; sources call the shape 4-1-4-1 with triangular combinations) and Brazil Jun 2016-Dec 2022 (4-1-4-1 flexing to 4-3-3, zonal marking confirmed by assistant Cleber Xavier at the 2018 World Cup). Start/end dates for Corinthians 2010-13 and the Brazil exit are from memory and unconfirmed (see openQuestions). Excluded: Gremio 2001-03 (Copa do Brasil 2001, 3-5-2 'retranqueiro' per Goal, but a single source and early career), Internacional 2008-09 (4-man defence, only thin coverage), Flamengo 2023-24 (no major title, outside the profile of his known style), Palmeiras, Atletico-MG, Al Ain, Sao Caetano. Sources use '4-1-4-1', 'zonal defence', 'triangular combinations'; a popular label 'retranqueiro/empatite' refers to the pre-2015 Corinthians and 2001 Gremio, not to Brazil.

openQuestions: Exact start of Corinthians spell 1 (set to 2010-12-01 from memory, not verified in any digest) and its end (late 2013; memory, unverified; Mano Menezes replaced him per sources).
Exact end date of Corinthians spell 2 (set to 2016-06-20 from memory, the Brazil appointment; digest only says 'appointed in June 2016') and start (Dec 2014/Jan 2015, not verified).
Brazil spell: start 2016-06-20 and end 2022-12-09 (after the Croatia quarter-final loss) are from memory; digests only confirm 'appointed in June 2016'.
Digest pages cover 2015 Corinthians and Brazil 2016-2018 well; Brazil 2019-2022 (Copa America 2019 win, 2021 final loss, Qatar 2022) and Corinthians 2011-13 pressing/transitions are thinly covered.
Cleber Xavier (assistant) describes the zonal defence, not Tite himself; treated as the coaching staff's method since Tite is quoted as sharing the 'methodology' of Corinthians.
Whether to count Gremio 2001-03 (Copa do Brasil) and Internacional 2008-09 (Sudamericana) is a judgement; excluded here because tactical coverage found is one paragraph or two.
Lance (2023) describes Tite's Brazil system as basically the same as Corinthians 2015; Raphael Rabello disputes labelling him a positional-play coach (search summary only, not mined).
